name: Meta Quest 3S

desc.en: The Quest 3S shares the same Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 chip and full app library as the Quest 3, at a significantly lower price. It's the perfect gateway to modern VR: fully standalone with color passthrough — no PC or console needed.
desc.es: El Quest 3S comparte el mismo procesador Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 y la biblioteca completa del Quest 3, a un precio significativamente menor. Es la puerta de entrada perfecta al VR moderno: standalone con passthrough color, sin PC ni consola.

schema_description: Standalone VR headset with Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2, full-color mixed reality passthrough, and access to the complete Meta Quest app library. No PC or console required.
